title: ASSEMBLY OF SUN ROOF / INSTALLATION OF SUN ROOF

items: APPLY MP GREASE TO DRIVE CABLE
PLACE DRIVE CABLES INTO GUIDE CASING
INSTALL FRONT AND REAR SHOES ONTO ROOF PANEL

content.description: Hand applying grease to drive cable mechanism, with shim labeled

items.main: INSTALL GUIDE RAILS ON BOTH SIDES
sub_items: (a) Install both side guide rails through the rear and front shoes.
(b) Install the guide rail and guide casing with the screws.
(c) Use butyl tape to cover the cut portion of the weatherstrip at the connection between the guide case and guide rail.

content.description: Sun roof panel with guide rails being installed on both sides
Close-up detail of butyl tape application at weatherstrip connection point, with inset showing detail

sub_items: (a) Run the headlining through the guide rail.

content.text: NOTE: Secure the headlining for adjustment after assembly.

content.description: Headlining being threaded through guide rail of sun roof assembly

items.main: INSTALL SLIDING ROOF WITH GUIDE RAIL ONTO ROOF
sub_items: (a) Install the sliding roof assembly onto the roof.
(b) Tighten the guide rail and cover with the screws.

content.description: Complete sun roof assembly being installed onto vehicle roof, showing sliding roof with guide rails
